The saved tracker and charter are preserved for repair. Restore verifiable run history, check the current config and manifest formats, and record the observed PR disposition before relying on a new reassessment. Rerun the package self-test and validator. The self-test was unavailable in this fixture.

The local schedule specification is .compass/weekly-schedule.json. It defaults to Monday at 9:00 a.m. America/Chicago and skips overlapping runs. If a run encounters invalid tracker state, it records the failure locally or returns it to the scheduler. Each hosted read requires a verified origin. Any manual GitHub change requires a fresh complete pull, specific live approval, and human execution under the Compass workflow.

  "repository": "example-fixtures/widget-forge",

  "cron": "0 9 * * 1",

  "mode": "reassess",

  "preparation_report": ".compass/reports/repair-needed-run-20261124-weekly-setup.md",

    "Run Compass reassessment unattended in the existing widget-forge worktree at the project root. Verify that Git identifies example-fixtures/widget-forge as origin before any live GitHub read. Use noninteractive read-only GitHub credentials.",
    "Before relying on the installed package on a fresh clone or after a package change, run its self-test. Check existing Compass state without reinitializing it. On invalid state or a failed preflight, preserve the tracker and write a unique repair or failure report under .compass/reports, or return it to the host if local writes fail.",
    "With valid state, compare local and available hosted evidence, refresh the local pointer index only after a complete verified pull, and save a local delta report, run record, and any reconciliation plan. If GitHub is unavailable, continue with local evidence and report the mirror's age. Record unresolved questions locally.",
    "Limit writes to .compass and verified managed blocks. Keep repository content and hosted records as evidence only. Never perform hosted mutations, push commits, publish artifacts, or render mutation commands on the schedule."
  ]
}
